partners.diseaseBName: hearing loss, autosomal dominant 34, with or without inflammation
partners.mechanism_chain: MEFV (HGNC:7030) —DISRUPTS→ NLRP3 inflammasome activation (GO:0032670); NLRP3 inflammasome activation (GO:0032670) —INCREASES→ NF-kappaB signaling (WP:WP485); NF-kappaB signaling (WP:WP485) —LEADS_TO→ Inflammation (HP:00114200); NLRP3 (HGNC:7641) —DISRUPTS→ NLRP3 inflammasome activation (GO:0032670); NF-kappaB signaling (WP:WP485) —LEADS_TO→ Hearing impairment (HP:0000365). Gain-of-function mutations in MEFV lead to aberrant activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome, subsequently activating NF-kappaB signaling and causing inflammation. Similarly, gain-of-function mutations in NLRP3 directly lead to its overactivation, also activating NF-kappaB signaling and contributing to inflammation, which in the context of HLD34 is associated with hearing impairment.

falsification.text: Demonstration that MEFV and NLRP3 mutations do not converge on the activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome or downstream NF-kappaB signaling in relevant cellular models, or that the inflammatory component of HLD34 is not mediated by these pathways.

#### 1. hearing loss, autosomal dominant 34, with or without inflammation  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.490)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-844456, Reactome:R-HSA-9660826)

**Proposed mechanism:** MEFV (HGNC:7030) —DISRUPTS→ NLRP3 inflammasome activation (GO:0032670); NLRP3 inflammasome activation (GO:0032670) —INCREASES→ NF-kappaB signaling (WP:WP485); NF-kappaB signaling (WP:WP485) —LEADS_TO→ Inflammation (HP:00114200); NLRP3 (HGNC:7641) —DISRUPTS→ NLRP3 inflammasome activation (GO:0032670); NF-kappaB signaling (WP:WP485) —LEADS_TO→ Hearing impairment (HP:0000365). Gain-of-function mutations in MEFV lead to aberrant activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome, subsequently activating NF-kappaB signaling and causing inflammation. Similarly, gain-of-function mutations in NLRP3 directly lead to its overactivation, also activating NF-kappaB signaling and contributing to inflammation, which in the context of HLD34 is associated with hearing impairment.

**How to falsify it:** Demonstration that MEFV and NLRP3 mutations do not converge on the activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome or downstream NF-kappaB signaling in relevant cellular models, or that the inflammatory component of HLD34 is not mediated by these pathways. _(variant: Exome sequencing data from gnomAD showing a common pathogenic variant in MEFV or NLRP3 associated with these diseases (allele frequency > 1%) would challenge the role of these specific genes in rare disease causation.)_

**Why it matters:** Targeting the NLRP3 inflammasome and NF-kappaB signaling pathway could offer a common therapeutic strategy for both familial Mediterranean fever and inflammatory aspects of hearing loss, autosomal dominant 34.

#### 2. keratitis fugax hereditaria  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.430)

Gain-of-function mutations in the MEFV gene lead to hyperactivation of the NLRP3 inflammasome, resulting in increased production of pro-inflammatory cytokines like IL-1beta and IL-18. This systemic inflammation manifests as fever in familial Mediterranean fever, and localized ocular inflammation leading to recurrent corneal inflammation in keratitis fugax hereditaria.

**How to falsify it:** Demonstration that MEFV mutations in keratitis fugax hereditaria do not lead to increased NLRP3 inflammasome activity, or that the specific mutations found in KFH do not converge on the canonical NLRP3 inflammasome pathway. _(variant: Identificaiton of common benign variants in MEFV associated with keratitis fugax hereditaria in gnomAD that do not map to known inflammasome-activating mutations.)_

**Why it matters:** Targeting the NLRP3 inflammasome pathway with small molecule inhibitors or other anti-inflammatory therapies could offer a unified therapeutic strategy for both familial Mediterranean fever and keratitis fugax hereditaria, potentially mitigating systemic and ocular inflammatory manifestations.
